content.short: Non-custodial crypto payment gateway for businesses, with instant payouts and fees from 0.25%.
content.description: BlockBee lets merchants accept more than 70 cryptocurrencies and receive funds straight to their own wallets, optionally converted into the coin they prefer. There are no setup or monthly fees, integration works through an API or ready-made plugins, and payouts to others are supported too. It has processed over $100 million for more than 10,000 merchants.
content.meta: Accept 70+ cryptocurrencies with BlockBee, a non-custodial payment gateway with instant payouts, plugins and no monthly fees.
